title: Inpage Navigation
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a Business User, I want to have flexible inpage navigation components with category nodes that can be displayed as both a grid and slider, so that I can present categorized content in an engaging and adaptable way.

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

These requirements apply to all 3 variants of Inpage Navigation

* **Display Options:**

    * Category nodes can be displayed in grid layout
    * Category nodes can be displayed in slider format
    * Users can switch between display modes
    * Optional Headings (Caption, Headline, Subline) can be displayed
    * Category nodes can have flags
    
* **Category Node Features:**

    * Each node contains an image and title
    * Each node is linked to a category
    * The user can choose whether to manually select categories and create nodes, or whether they should be created automatically (recommendations maybe not part of MVP?)
    
        * Show all subcategories from level X
        * Most popular categories/subcategories
        * Category recommendations based on
        
            * the product viewed
            * recently viewed categories and products
            
        
    * Background color of nodes is customizable (We therefore recommend using transparent images)
    * Flags can be added manually
    * System can automatically assign flags based on predefined rules
    
* **"Sale" Mode:**

    * One-click activation of "Sale" mode
    * Visual appearance of nodes changes in "Sale" mode
    * Sale-specific styling can be predefined

## Scrollbar

[https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=9228-30959&t=WGKlkG3l0TsCUryI-4](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=9228-30959&t=WGKlkG3l0TsCUryI-4)The scrollbar indicates how much content of a slider is currently visible and where you are.

**Example:**

* A slider has 18 items.
* On mobile, 3 items are always visible at once. The bar (b) is then the width (w) of the entire bar / 6 long. b = w/6 
* On desktop, 6 items are always visible, i.e.:   
  b = w/3

Please note that the handle/bar requires a clickable area of at least 24px height/width. therefore the component has padding to symbolize this.

‌

## Inpage Navigation Basic

### Category Nodes / Basic

Category nodes are the basic element in an online store to promote categories and make them visible to customers outside the main navigation. Especially on mobile devices, where the main menu is hidden behind a burger. The basic variant is a classic that has proven itself in many online stores.

| Are used in the Inpage Navigation Grid and Slider.  Are **themed** components. Have the following properties/variants: device mobile/desktop variant: default SALE see more color on light background on dark background on bright background state default hover pressed focus has flag true/false |    Please ignore that for mobile & desktop the size of the nodes in figma appears the same. for other themes the sizes may be different. |
| --- | --- |
| **Requirements** in addition to the default settings for the background color of the image, users can change the color afterwards (see example images on the right) you can find some design and usage examples [here](https://www.figma.com/design/92moLelAY8lh8mI0rhCGzy/laioutr-UI?node-id=9131-104078&t=WGKlkG3l0TsCUryI-4): ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=3a11f67c-40cd-4b9d-b25e-7541e111ce98&&collection=&height=531&occurrenceKey=null&width=670&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) | ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=7fbd046c-41e3-45da-8143-70f0633c5757&&collection=&height=423&occurrenceKey=null&width=385&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) has green/6 as background color and green/3 as node background color ![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=6e5a1baa-ec23-4c5a-9283-7940f126877a&&collection=&height=460&occurrenceKey=null&width=402&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null) this one is **not dark mode** but has variant "on dark background", section background default/black (which stays black in dark mode) and white alpha/6 as node background color. |

## Inpage Navigation Compact

### Category Nodes / Compact

Category nodes are the basic element in an online store to promote categories and make them visible to customers outside the main navigation. Especially on mobile devices, where the main menu is hidden behind a burger. The compact variant is particularly useful when the space in the first fold is limited. For example on product listing pages. 

| Are used in the Inpage Navigation / Compact /Grid and Slider.  Are **themed** components. Have the following properties/variants: device mobile/desktop variant (design variants): default outline solid default sale outline sale solid sale default see more outline see more solid see more color on light background on dark background on bright background bg color none light bg dark bg bright bg pale sale red state default hover pressed focus has flag true/false |    |
| --- | --- |
| **Requirements** in addition to the default settings for the background color of the image, users can change the color afterwards The "see more" variant functions as a button/link to the supercategory / listing page.  Consequently, it should be possible to specify either a category ID or a URL. this creates freedom for the creativity of our customers. The see more variant **is optional** |  |

enrichedData.purpose: Enables business users to present categorized content through flexible inpage navigation components with category nodes that can be displayed as both grid and slider layouts, making categories visible outside the main navigation especially on mobile devices.

Switch between display modes as needed
Add promotional flags to category nodes manually or automatically
Manually select categories or auto-generate from subcategories
Display most popular categories or personalized recommendations
Customize node background color for transparent images
Activate Sale mode with one click for visual styling changes
Link 'see more' variant to category ID or custom URL
Choose between Basic, Compact, and Big node variants
Select node format: square, rectangle landscape, or rectangle portrait
Position text on image or below image for Big variant

Position navigation buttons above or below slider
